- [Few-Shot Learning Agents](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/few-shot-learning-agents/): Few-shot learning agents operate by leveraging prior knowledge, often gained from pre-training on large datasets, and then adapting this knowledge to new, specific tasks using only a handful of examples .
- [Multi-Modal Agents](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/multi-modal-agents/): Multi-Modal Agents are sophisticated artificial intelligence systems designed to process, understand, and generate information from multiple types of data sources.

- [Swarm Intelligence](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/swarm-intelligence/): Swarm intelligence is a collective AI approach inspired by nature, where simple agents work together to solve complex problems. It enables coordination, adaptability, and smarter decision-making through group behavior rather than individual intelligence.
- [Embedding Models](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/embedding-models/): AI is just a calculator without embeddings. Learn what embedding models are, how they work, and why they are the core &quot;brain&quot; behind semantic search, AI agents, and RAG.

It ensures reliability, scalability, and performance by streamlining workflows like model updates, evaluation, logging, and continuous improvement.
- [Data Preprocessing](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/data-preprocessing/): Data preprocessing is the step of cleaning, transforming, and organizing raw data before training an AI or machine learning model. It improves data quality, reduces noise, and ensures models learn from accurate, consistent, and well-structured information.
- [Contrastive learning](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/contrastive-learning/): Contrastive learning is a machine learning technique that trains models to recognize similarities and differences between data pairs. By comparing examples, it helps AI learn meaningful representations—improving tasks like image recognition, text understanding, and clustering.
- [Ground Truth](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/ground-truth-in-machine-learning/): Ground truth in machine learning refers to the accurate, real-world data used as a benchmark to train and evaluate models. It represents the true labels or outcomes, helping AI systems learn correctly and measure their performance against reality.
- [Human-in-the-loop](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/human-in-the-loop/): Human-in-the-loop (HITL) is an AI approach where human feedback is integrated into the model’s training or decision-making. It ensures higher accuracy, ethical alignment, and reliability by combining human judgment with machine efficiency.
- [Chain of thought](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/chain-of-thought/): Chain of thought refers to the step-by-step reasoning process an AI model uses to reach an answer. It helps the model explain its logic, improve accuracy, and solve complex problems by breaking them down into smaller, logical steps.
- [API Gateway](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/api-gateway/): An API gateway is a management layer that handles, secures, and routes requests between clients and backend services. It simplifies API integration, improves performance, and enables authentication, monitoring, and scalability for modern applications.
- [Vector Databases](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/vector-databases/): Vector databases store and search data as numerical embeddings, enabling AI to find similar meanings instead of exact matches. They power semantic search, recommendation systems, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) by making AI understanding more context-aware.
- [Model distillation](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-model-distillation/): Model distillation is the process of transferring knowledge from a large, complex AI model to a smaller one. It helps create faster, more efficient models that retain high accuracy while reducing computational cost and resource usage.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-prompt-engineering/): Prompt engineering is the practice of designing effective inputs or instructions to get accurate, relevant results from AI models. It helps shape the model’s behavior, improve output quality, and unlock better performance across tasks like writing, coding, and analysis.
- [Grounding in AI](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-grounding-in-ai/): Grounding in AI refers to how models connect language or symbols to real-world meaning. It ensures AI systems truly understand context—linking words, data, or actions to actual experiences, objects, and facts for more accurate and reliable responses.
- [Ambient Agents](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-are-ambient-agents/): Ambient agents are AI systems that work quietly in the background, sensing context and acting proactively without direct commands. They enhance user experience by anticipating needs, automating tasks, and blending seamlessly into everyday environments.
- [Complexity Threshold](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-complexity-threshold/): A complexity threshold is the point at which a task or system becomes too complex for an AI model to handle effectively. It marks the limit of the model’s reasoning, memory, or computational capacity—beyond which performance and accuracy start to decline.
- [Agent Evals](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-agent-evals/): Agent evals are methods used to test and measure how well AI agents perform specific tasks. They assess accuracy, reliability, reasoning, and real-world effectiveness—helping teams improve agent performance and ensure consistent results.
- [Long term Coherence](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-long-term-coherence/): Long-term coherence is an AI’s ability to stay consistent and context-aware over time. It ensures conversations, writing, or reasoning remain logical, aligned, and relevant across longer interactions or documents.
- [Deterministic Reasoning](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-deterministic-reasoning/): Deterministic reasoning is a logical process where the same inputs always produce the same outputs. In AI, it means decisions follow fixed rules or algorithms—ensuring consistency, predictability, and transparency in how results are generated.
- [Context window](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-context-window/): A context window is the amount of information an AI model can remember and process at once. It defines how much past conversation or data the model uses to generate accurate, relevant responses. Larger context windows enable deeper understanding and continuity.
- [Headless AI Agent](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/what-is-headless-ai-agent/): A headless agent is an AI agent that works entirely in the background—without a user interface. Discover the benefits of using GAN models for data generation and enhancement, along with key components for effective GAN implementation.
- [Fine-Tuning](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/fine-tuning/): Discover how fine-tuning optimizes model performance. Learn about the benefits of hyperparameter adjustment and key techniques for specific tasks.
- [F1 Score](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/f1-score/): Don’t trust accuracy alone! F1 Score gives the full picture by measuring precision and recall together. Learn how it works!
- [Feature Engineering](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/feature-engineering/): Want better ML results? Feature engineering is the secret sauce! Find out how the right features can take your model from average to amazing.
- [Ensemble Learning](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/ensemble-learning/): One model is good, but multiple models are better! Discover how ensemble learning boosts AI accuracy with smarter predictions.
- [Epochs](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/epochs/): Epochs define how many times a model sees your data. Like teaching a kid math by repeating problems, more epochs, better results.
- [Edge Computing](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/edge-computing/): Tired of slow AI responses? Edge computing brings real-time processing closer to you. See how it’s changing the game for AI applications.
- [Feature Selection](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/feature-selection/): Too many features slowing down your model? Feature selection is the key to speed and accuracy! Learn the best techniques here.
- [Dimensionality Reduction](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/dimensionality-reduction/): Too much data slows AI down. Dimensionality reduction helps models focus on what matters. Learn how it works.
- [Few-Shot Learning](https://www.lyzr.ai/glossaries/few-shot-learning/): Train AI with less data? Few-shot learning makes it possible! Discover how models learn from just a handful of examples.
